featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review out of sheer frustration and disappointment with the level of customer service at Pantaloons. It’s truly disheartening to see such a well-known brand hiring staff who are clearly not trained to handle customers properly.

Recently, I visited one of your stores to purchase some clothes. The sales staff were extremely pushy, practically forcing me to buy items rather than genuinely helping me find what I needed. It felt more like pressure than assistance, which is unacceptable.

To make matters worse, I am flying to Dubai this evening and needed urgent help. I called your customer care and was assisted by someone named Sanjana—without a doubt, the most unprofessional and unhelpful experience I’ve had with any brand. She had no active listening skills, showed zero empathy, and gave me an invalid store contact number. I’ve since spent a frustrating amount of time trying to reach the store manager, with no success. Calls get dropped or ignored, and no one takes accountability.

This kind of treatment towards paying, loyal customers is completely unacceptable. If this is the standard Pantaloons is setting, it's deeply disappointing. Your team leaves customers hanging and adds stress instead of solving problems.

I hope this review is taken seriously and that immediate steps are taken to improve customer service—starting with better training and accountability.

Suggestion: Please ensure shoe sizes are properly checked and matched before billing to avoid wasting customers’ time.

THE THREE MONTH NIGHTMARE CONTINUES…

It has now been 2 months since I requested a refund on an item that I had returned (within the return timeframe) and was asked by their team whether I wanted a full refund or store credit. I made it abundantly clear over a series of 15 emails that I wanted a full refund back to my original form of payment. (Fifteen emails because every time a new representative replies and the whole saga has to be explained again as the representatives do not make the effort to read the previous emails.)

Today after 2 whole months I discovered that they have gone ahead and issued me a store credit anyway and further subtracted a 10% restocking fee without informing me. Why will I EVER buy from them again after such an abysmal customer experience?!?

I would like an IMMEDIATE refund of my returned item WITHOUT arbitrary deductions and a follow up call from their team.

featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a cute little shop located in the Kala Ghoda area. I preferred this outlet over their Khira Nagar outlet because I thought location might influence the collection, choice and size, but that is not true I guess.

I purchased one kurti in Sunshine Yellow color. I liked a few others too, but the downside of this brand is - if a M size kurti fits you nicely, it is not absolutely necessary that other kurti in M size will fit you. Fit varies according to cut and fabric. So, I guess there's no point buying their clothes online. You will have to go to the physical store, try and see for yourself and then purchase.

For a store which has varying sizes according to different factors, collection was painfully limited. I was interested in visiting them after watching them on insta for years, but I don't think it lived up to my expectations.

I will visit their Santacruz outlet, which happens to be their first ever physical store, and see if I have different experiences after all.
